comment: Declared 854370 ('other electrical machines and apparatus with individual functions') is only partially right: it plausibly covers the electronic jamming/spoofing/direction-finding units, but it is a residual code and does not describe the company's core goods. The flagship products are unmanned aerial vehicles (interceptor drone Zombee) → Ch. 8806, and radar/radio navigation-and-surveillance apparatus (GNSS spoofers, RF jammers, protocol analysers, direction finders) → 8526, which are more specific than 854370. The anti-drone patrol vehicle 'Ranger' is a vehicle-mounted system (Ch. 87) and is entirely absent from the declaration. SkyOS™ is software/services (Ch. 85 software media or Ch. 99 services), also not reflected. Industry label 'IT и электроника' is a misclassification: this is defence electronics / aerospace (counter-UAS, military and border security), not general IT. No trader signs. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground — company is retained with corrected codes. All product information above is from the company's own website (indrajaal.in home, /about-us/, /indrajaal-zombee/, /indrajaal-repulsor/, /indrajaal-ranger/) — i.e. заявлено, не подтверждено: no customs line, shipping bill or B-L record was checked in this task (out of scope), so no product line here is corroborated by a customs entry. Revenue, export volumes, CIN/PAN and registration data were not researched per task scope — null.
